profile.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice is a federal agency led by the Attorney General. Its mission is to uphold the rule of law, keep the country safe, and protect civil rights. It includes more than 30 component organizations, such as the Office of Community Oriented Policing Services (COPS Office), which awards grants to law enforcement agencies.

sources.title: Contact Us | United States Department of Justice

review.notes: OUSD's records name the U.S. Department of Justice (Washington, DC) as grantor of the COPS School Violence Prevention Program; justice.gov and cops.usdoj.gov confirm the name, address, phone, mission, 30+ components, and the COPS Office and SVPP. The summary is supported and neutral.
